# Agents Instructions

## Overview
This .NET solution is a collections of different projets that demostrate the use of Azure Entra ID authentication in different scenarios:
- aspnetcore10 : asp.net core 10 web-application with Entra ID authentication
- aspnetframework48 : asp.net framework 4.8 web-application with Entra ID authentication

Other information can be found in the README.md file.

## User Preferences
- in aspnetcore10 web application, `appsettings.local.json` must be copied to output folder for local app execution.
